title: Number of Ways to Arrive at Destination
summary: Given a city with n intersections numbered from 0 to n-1, where each intersection is connected to other intersections via bi-directional roads, and each road has a specified travel time, determine the number of ways to travel from intersection 0 to intersection n-1 in the shortest possible time.
statement: Given a city with n intersections numbered from 0 to n-1, where each intersection is connected to other intersections via bi-directional roads, and each road has a specified travel time, determine the number of ways to travel from intersection 0 to intersection n-1 in the shortest possible time. The result should be returned modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: 2 <= n <= 200; roads is an undirected connected graph with positive travel times and no duplicate edge.
Count distinct paths from zero to n-1 whose travel time is minimum.
reference_solution:
def count_shortest_routes(n, roads):
    from heapq import heappop, heappush
    mod = 1_000_000_007
    graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for a, b, travel_time in roads:
        graph[a].append((b, travel_time))
        graph[b].append((a, travel_time))
    distance = [float('inf')] * n
    ways = [0] * n
    distance[0] = 0
    ways[0] = 1
    heap = [(0, 0)]
    while heap:
        elapsed, node = heappop(heap)
        if elapsed > distance[node]:
            continue
        for neighbor, cost in graph[node]:
            candidate = elapsed + cost
            if candidate < distance[neighbor]:
                distance[neighbor] = candidate
                ways[neighbor] = ways[node]
                heappush(heap, (candidate, neighbor))
            elif candidate == distance[neighbor]:
                ways[neighbor] = (ways[neighbor] + ways[node]) % mod
    return ways[n - 1]
